title: Improve logical BIT packing to c > 0.00174305936 with exact mixed-width owners
body:
PR4183's five admitted rank-four helpers retain an inherited owner allocation. This contribution places their exact terminal operators in stage-eligible idle windows, reducing the full BIT request count **902,592 → 901,312**, with unchanged local word, 660 arbitrary RAW inputs, original stock 28,416 and rank mass 1,808,352. All remaining idle coordinates are returned and charged; nine private families supply no original DATA credit.

The conservative moment root is strictly bracketed by

```
1743059363170060183941 / 10^24
1743059363170060183942 / 10^24
```

The lower endpoint is **0.31235% above** PR4183 head `59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1`'s upper bracket `434407954621501888371 / 250000000000000000000000`. A sufficient actual logical separator is **b = 871/500000 = 0.001742**, with

```
T(n,w) <= 200 C n + 2400000 C n^(1-b) w.
```

This is a **conditional source-bound logical p=1 BIT supplier**, for fixed prime q>2^80 on the retained canonical/root-coupled domain and compatible fresh-row stock. Fixed physical tapes, physical arena cleanup, arbitrary-stock outer padding and the multiplication join remain open. The selected whole κ and complex supplier are unchanged; no maintainer approval or independent human certification is claimed.

The new assignment covers 288 local calls and 126,144 helper occurrences. Exact terminal charts, physical supports, arbitrary-input COPY guards, pair chronology and full idle return are checked. The historical selector tariff rises from 1117 to 1149 and the route bound from 151 to 159; those costs are explicit. The latest logical matrix compiler is retained and replayed against the new Catalogue/Topology/Consumer.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered normal and `-O` replays, separate code-disjoint SOURCE/operator and exact rational-price checks, actual complete caller/Frame/threshold probes, six semantic/source negative controls, raw committed-byte/source-history preflight, and fresh Git-free committed exports. Exact outcomes and limitations are in `VALIDATION.json`. The verifier is standard-library-only. These are internal assisted checks, not hosted CI results or a formal-kernel multiplication theorem.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-stage-mixedwidth-packing
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-stage-mixedwidth-packing --check-source-history
```

The pending predecessor's exact bytes are retained locally with original paths/blob IDs/SHA256 in `SOURCE-ORIGINS.json`; replay does not fetch an unmerged head. `RECORD.json` separates the moment bracket, actual separator, comparison and publication status. `TASK.json` records the original selected-packing card and the human-assigned BIT scope change. `OVERLAP.json` records the read-only overlap check; it is not a novelty certificate.
